payload.text: TOOLS THAT ANSWER CLEANLY WITHOUT MEASURING. The Bash tool's shell is zsh: no word splitting (cb59bcf9 left four events out on it), $pipestatus[1] for ${PIPESTATUS[0]}, a glob that matches nothing aborts the command, a word opening with = is a path lookup, [ has no <, and no $EPOCHREALTIME. Bare grep is ugrep, which refuses a .{0,90} pattern with rc 2 and no output; bare find is bfs; BSD grep has no -P; git grep -E has no \b. Also clean and wrong: BSD cmp -n exits 1 at EOF though every byte matched; a remote-tracking ref is a cached opinion; jq over board.json counts archived rows (select state=="live"); intent issues list lists open issues only. Run anything with arrays, splitting, string comparisons or a pipeline's status under bash <<'BASH', and drive a check red once before trusting its green.
